<a id="覆盖与证据含义--coverage-and-evidence"></a>
## Coverage and evidence

This reading edition covers **140 chapters** (current and moved to history) and **17 branch READMEs** at their recorded source versions. 80 entries name a source that changed after the reading; they are marked on their pages and await a reread. Additional chapters, changed source versions and session outcomes also appear in the [checkpoint map](SESSION-RESULTS.md). Navigation updates do not certify old summaries or refresh their review hashes. Chapters are reading units, not independent theories or theorems; full arguments, criticism and proofs remain at their original locations.

| Category | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Checked conditional result | Formal inference under specified definitions and hypotheses; correspondence and normative warrant remain separate. |
| Philosophical or textual argument | Argument, criticism and sources; missing direct formalization stays visible. |
| Historical mathematics | Retains its original hand-proof, computation or historical-check scope. |
| Empirical or synthetic evidence | Real studies, correspondence and finite simulations keep distinct scopes. |
| Open research | Targets, conjectures and proposed tests, not completed results. |

Under the shared [nondual method](../chapters/NONDUAL-METHOD.md), roles, boundaries, knowing and evaluation are differentiated relations within one unfolding. The catalogue’s categories organize reading; they do not split reality into independent domains. Positive results, losses and counterexamples remain visible.

<a id="维护--maintenance"></a>
## Maintenance

The entries are kept in the reading registers [A–L](data/arguments-a-l.json), [M–Z](data/arguments-m-z.json) and [branches](data/theory-map.json), with both languages where written. `source_sha256` records the inspected version; a changed source requires a targeted reread before its hash is refreshed. Generated views record `generated-view`; their rows follow the record checks. Continue substantive work in the existing study files.

```sh
make research-render                                   # writes these pages with the other generated views
python3 -B tools/research/reading_catalogue.py --check  # coverage, fields, links and reading drift
python3 -B tools/research/lean_catalogue.py --check
```

These checks validate documentation, links and snapshots, not Lean proofs. Formal results are reproduced through each package’s own instructions. The earlier editing record is kept in [the root-foundation study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RESULTS-CATALOGUE-RECORD.md).
